purpose: Bounded matched learning pilot after verified leg-adduction diagnosis; not the reward-3.3 comparison

target_envelope.cost: Sum of absolute requested-target excess beyond the declared joint-specific bounds
target_envelope.rationale: The fixed-policy hip target guard eliminated crossed foot sites but did not restore tracking. Teach bounded requests through reward while retaining unmodified action execution, so learning can adjust balance. Other joints also show large overdrive. Weight is an exploratory starting point from saved excess magnitude, not a tuned optimum.

sole_between_arm_change: One added reward term in target_envelope; no action clipping or physics change
restore: Same checkpoint weights, Adam, adaptive rate, observation normalization and curriculum; fresh seed-matched environment/episode/RNG history
evaluation: Last checkpoint only, ONNX 1000-frame parity, unchanged five commands x 32 first episodes x 20 seconds, seed 1001; report actual joint posture, signed foot gap, raw target excess, tracking and falls
acceptance: A training pilot is informative even if it fails. Do not claim repair unless all original gait criteria pass and saved traces show no sustained inward-limit posture or crossed foot sites. No hidden held-out selection or hardware acceptance.
postprocessing_failure_policy: Keep completed learning; repair exports/analysis from saved data without retraining
